messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Perform Mixture IRT Model
parts:
Hi Esteban,

Unfortunately, mirt doesn't support mixture distributions yet (one day perhaps). I only recently added latent class estimation in to the package, so mixtures are probably within reach but will still take a good amount of time to write and test. I think your best bet at this stage is to look to Mplus for obtaining those results. Cheers.

Phil
